items.name: motion-animated-background
items.title: Animated Background
items.description: Moves a shared background between selected or hovered child elements.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed the cn import from @/lib/utils to ../../lib/utils for source-batch and install-target portability.
Added a useReducedMotion branch that removes the shared layout id and snaps opacity changes.
Added focus, blur, and click parity to hover mode so keyboard and touch users can set the same active state.

modifications.change: Changed the local utility import, added a reduced-motion snap, and added keyboard/touch parity to hover mode.
modifications.reason: Resolve the copied helper without a consumer root alias and keep the selection behavior usable without hover or animated layout movement.

items.name: motion-dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: Magnifies application actions according to pointer proximity.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed the cn import from @/lib/utils to ../../lib/utils for source-batch and install-target portability.
Added useReducedMotion handling that keeps the dock and item widths static and makes tooltip feedback immediate.
Changed the focusable role=button wrapper to a native button and require an accessible aria-label.

credits: Motion Primitives docs credit @kashyap20 and cite Build UI – Magnified Dock as inspiration.

modifications.change: Changed the local utility import, disabled magnification for reduced motion, and replaced the simulated button with a labelled native button.
modifications.reason: Resolve the copied helper, keep the dock static when motion is reduced, and preserve native keyboard/touch activation and naming.

items.name: motion-morphing-dialog
items.title: Morphing Dialog
items.description: Expands a trigger into a modal dialog with shared-layout motion.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed local utility and click-outside imports from root aliases to ../../lib/utils and ../../hooks/useClickOutside.
Applied the caller transition through one MotionConfig and added an instant reduced-motion configuration.
Connected the internal trigger ref, removed duplicate native-button keyboard handling, fixed dialog label/description ids, and restored focus on close.
Scoped keyboard trapping to the open state, focused the dialog when it has no focusable child, and cleaned up the body scroll-lock class on close or unmount.
Applied the existing container className and style props that upstream declared but did not forward.

modifications.change: Changed local imports and made narrow reduced-motion, focus, semantic-id, and cleanup repairs without changing the compound component API.
modifications.reason: Resolve copied helpers, provide an instant reduced-motion path, and make the upstream modal behavior safe enough to stage for browser review.

items.name: motion-morphing-popover
items.title: Morphing Popover
items.description: Expands a trigger into a shared-layout popover.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed local utility and click-outside imports from root aliases to ../../lib/utils and ../../hooks/useClickOutside.
Added an instant useReducedMotion MotionConfig path.
Tracked the trigger, moved focus into the open popover, restored it on close, and made the dialog non-modal while retaining Escape and touch outside dismissal.
Memoized open and close callbacks so parent rerenders do not tear down and restart the focus effect.

modifications.change: Changed local imports and added reduced-motion plus stable non-modal focus management.
modifications.reason: Resolve copied helpers, snap the shared-layout transition when requested, and align focus behavior with a dismissible non-modal popover.

items.name: motion-progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: Builds a directional blur overlay from layered masks.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed the cn import from @/lib/utils to ../../lib/utils for source-batch and install-target portability.
Added a zero-duration useReducedMotion transition override for caller-supplied motion props.
Marked generated blur layers as decorative.

modifications.change: Changed the local utility import, snapped optional motion props for reduced motion, and hid decorative layers from assistive technology.
modifications.reason: Resolve the copied helper and keep the static blur readable without exposing or animating its generated layers.

items.name: motion-scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: Maps page or container scroll progress to a horizontal indicator.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed the cn import from @/lib/utils to ../../lib/utils for source-batch and install-target portability.
Used the direct scroll motion value instead of the spring when reduced motion is requested.
Allowed a nullable container ref for current React ref typing.

modifications.change: Changed the local utility import, bypassed spring lag for reduced motion, and widened the container ref type to include null.
modifications.reason: Resolve the copied helper, keep progress directly tied to scroll position under reduced motion, and compile with current React ref types.

items.name: motion-text-effect
items.title: Text Effect
items.description: Reveals text by line, word, or character with configurable variants.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed the cn import from @/lib/utils to ../../lib/utils for source-batch and install-target portability.
Rendered the final semantic text without segmentation or animation when reduced motion is requested.

modifications.change: Changed the local utility import and added a final-text reduced-motion branch.
modifications.reason: Resolve the copied helper and keep the phrase immediately readable as one semantic text node.

items.name: motion-text-loop
items.title: Text Loop
items.description: Cycles between caller-provided text or content children.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed the cn import from @/lib/utils to ../../lib/utils for source-batch and install-target portability.
Changed autoplay to opt-in by default, stopped its interval for reduced motion, and rendered the current child without a transition.
Skipped interval setup when fewer than two children are present.

modifications.change: Changed the local utility import, made autoplay opt-in, and added reduced-motion and empty/single-child interval guards.
modifications.reason: Resolve the copied helper and prevent unrequested or unnecessary timed text changes.

items.name: motion-text-morph
items.title: Text Morph
items.description: Morphs matching characters between successive text strings.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed the cn import from @/lib/utils to ../../lib/utils for source-batch and install-target portability.
Rendered the updated text as one static semantic node when reduced motion is requested.

credits: Motion Primitives docs cite the Family app as inspiration.

modifications.change: Changed the local utility import and added an immediate-text reduced-motion branch.
modifications.reason: Resolve the copied helper and keep updated text readable without character layout motion.

items.name: motion-tilt
items.title: Tilt
items.description: Applies pointer-position-driven three-dimensional tilt to a child.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Added useReducedMotion handling that omits the generated 3D transform and pointer tracking while preserving caller styles.

modifications.change: Disabled generated transforms and pointer tracking when reduced motion is requested.
modifications.reason: Keep the child static and its hit area stable without replacing the upstream tilt implementation.

items.name: motion-transition-panel
items.title: Transition Panel
items.description: Transitions between caller-provided panels by active index.
items.author: Motion Primitives

changes: Changed the cn import from @/lib/utils to ../../lib/utils for source-batch and install-target portability.
Rendered only the active panel with animation props disabled and a zero-duration transition when reduced motion is requested.

modifications.change: Changed the local utility import and added an instant active-panel reduced-motion branch.
modifications.reason: Resolve the copied helper and keep inactive panels out of the rendered focus order without enter or exit motion.
